blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR. Existing methods achieve this by learning alignment only at the level of whole scenes or objects, which provides no supervision for the fine-grained local structure within them. In this work, we show that supervision on a set of sparse 2D-3D correspondences, without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives, is sufficient to train a single model for both scene- and instance-level retrieval. Specifically, we propose $\textbf{CrossWeave}$, a novel framework for cross-modal retrieval that learns sparse patch-point alignment, which alone outperforms existing methods. An optimal transport-based aggregator over the aligned features gives further gains by clustering structurally redundant regions, freeing descriptor capacity for semantically distinct local features. CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art performance on both scene- and instance-level retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a $\textit{single model}$, whereas existing methods require separate models for each task. Our results suggest that whole-scene encoding is unnecessary for cross-modal retrieval and that sparse local correspondence supervision is a more effective and flexible alternative.
blocks.zh: 跨模式场景和实例检索旨在取回相应的3D环境或给定的查询2D图像对象,作为机器人和AR/VR空间推理的基础机制. 现有方法通过只学习整个场景或物体的校正来达到这个目的,这种校正无法对内部精细的局部结构进行监督. 在这项工作中,我们显示,对一组稀少的2D-3D通信进行监管,没有场景或实例层面的对比目标,就足以为场景和实例层面的检索培训单一模式。 具体地说,我们提议$\textbf{CrossWeave}$,这是一个跨模式检索的新框架,它学习了稀有的补丁点对接,单靠它就超过了现有的方法。 将结构上多余的区域组合起来,将描述性能力腾出来,以便形成当地特有的特征,从而使基于运输的集聚器相对于对接性特征而言有了进一步的好处。 CrossWeave在ScanNet和3RScan的场景和实例级检索上都实现了最先进的性能,使用$\textit{ single model}$,而现有的方法需要针对每项任务分别使用模型. 我们的结果表明,全场编码对于跨模式检索来说是不必要的,而且很少的当地通信监督是一种更有效和灵活的选择。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Within autonomous navigation and mapping, processing continuous streams of image and point cloud data is a major computational bottleneck. Scene and instance retrieval provide a first-pass spatial reasoning step, enabling location- and object-specific downstream tasks without exhaustive search over large databases or 3D maps. Such coarse reasoning is often sufficient for identifying object presence, recognizing the current environment, or initializing fine-grained localization and loop closure in SLAM. Cross-modal retrieval is especially valuable when the map is built using a richer sensor modality than the query device, such as a camera-equipped robot localizing against a LiDAR-built map, or an AR/VR device anchoring content to a pre-scanned environment.
blocks.zh: 在自主导航和绘图范围内,处理图像和点云数据的连续流是主要的计算瓶颈. 场景和实例检索提供了一个先行的空间推理步骤,使特定位置和对象的下游任务能够进行,而无需对大型数据库或三维地图进行彻底搜索。 这种粗糙的推理往往足以识别物体的存在,承认当前的环境,或者在SLAM中初始化了精细的本地化和环闭. 在使用比查询设备更丰富的传感器模式构建地图时,跨模式检索特别有价值,例如,一个相机设备的机器人在LiDAR所建地图上定位,或者一个AR/VR设备将内容锁定在被扫描前的环境中。

blocks.en: Formally, Cross-Modal Scene Retrieval (CMSR) is defined as retrieving, from a database of aligned 3D point cloud sub-maps, the sub-map corresponding to query RGB image(s). The related task of Cross-Modal Instance Retrieval (CMIR) is defined analogously: given RGB image(s) of an object, the system retrieves the corresponding 3D point cloud instance from a database of segmented object point clouds. CMSR remains an emerging problem, with few established methods for bridging the modality gap between 2D images and 3D maps. Existing approaches such as CrossOver [ 27 ] and SceneGraphLoc [ 19 ] rely on scene- or object-level supervision: CrossOver aligns modalities with separate scene- and instance-level contrastive objectives and requires a separate model for each task, while SceneGraphLoc matches image patches to the object nodes of a multimodal scene graph. In both cases, descriptors are learned using contrastive objectives similar to those used in visual place recognition [ 1 , 11 ] . However, both methods supervise alignment at the level of whole scenes or objects rather than individual 3D points.
blocks.zh: 形式上,Cross-Modal Scene Retrieval(CMSR)被定义为取回,从一个对齐的3D点云子地图的数据库中取回了对应查询RGB图像的子地图. Cross-Modal Ectory Retrieval (CMIR) 的相关任务被类似地定义:给定一个对象的RGB图像,系统从分块对象点云的数据库中取回相应的3D点云实例. CMSR仍然是一个新出现的问题,很少有既定的方法来弥合2D图像和3D地图之间的模式差距. CrossOver[27]和SceneGraphLoc[19]等现有方法依靠场景或物体层面的监督: 交叉 过度将模式与单独的场景级和实例级对比目标相匹配,并且需要为每项任务设置一个单独的模型,而SceneGraphLoc则将图像补丁与多模式场景图的对象节点相匹配. 在这两种情况下,描述词都采用与视觉位置识别中使用的目标相类似的对比目标[1,11]. 然而,这两种方法都监督整个场景或物体级别上的对齐,而不是单个3D分.

blocks.en: To address this, we propose CrossWeave , a cross-modal retrieval framework that learns from sparse local scene regions during training instead of aligning full scenes. CrossWeave introduces an image-patch-to-3D-point contrastive objective that preserves local cross-modal correspondences. It further aligns corresponding image-point cloud pairs using modality-specific descriptors obtained by aggregating local features, without requiring full-scene alignment. Using this architecture, we show that a single model trained with these losses, without any scene- or instance-level supervision, supports both scene- and object-level retrieval on the 3RScan and ScanNet benchmarks. We further demonstrate that patch-point alignment is the primary driver of instance retrieval performance, and improves scene retrieval when combined with learned aggregation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提议建立CrossWeave,这是一个跨模式的检索框架,在培训期间从稀少的地方景区学习,而不是调整全景。 CrossWeave引入了图像-patch-to-3D-点对比目标,保留了本地的跨模式通信. 它利用通过汇总本地特性而获得的特定模式描述符,进一步将相应的图像点云对进行对齐,而不需要全场对齐. 使用这种架构,我们显示,一个受过这些损失训练的单一模型,在没有任何场景或实例级监督的情况下,支持在3RScan和ScanNet基准上的场景和对象级检索。 我们进一步表明,补丁点对接是实例检索性能的主要驱动力,并在与学到的汇总相结合时改进场景检索。

blocks.en: • We propose CrossWeave , a novel multi-modal framework that performs both CMSR and CMIR with a single model, using a dual-contrastive loss at both the local patch-point level and the image-point cloud level, but not a scene/instance-level contrastive loss. This allows improved retrieval when compared to methods that encode the whole 3D map either as global point cloud features or scene graphs. • We show that adding local patch-point alignment consistently improves both CMSR and CMIR over training on aggregated descriptors alone, with the largest gains on fine-grained instance retrieval. • We achieve state-of-the-art performance on 3RScan and ScanNet, outperforming competing baselines by 21 points on scene retrieval and 8 points on instance retrieval on ScanNet.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们提出CrossWeave,这是一个全新的多模式框架,既以单一模式执行CMSR和CMIR,又使用局部补丁点和图像点云层的双重相接损失,但不是场景/内地级相接损失。 与将整个三维地图编码为全局点云特征或场景图的方法相比,这可以改进检索。 我们显示,增加局部补丁点对齐,不仅能改进CMSR和CMIR,而且能改进关于汇总描述符的培训,在精细实例检索方面取得最大进展。 我们在3RScan和ScanNet上实现了最先进的性能,在现场检索时比竞争基准高出21分,在ScanNet上比竞争基准高出8分。

blocks.en: We propose CrossWeave , a novel multi-modal framework that performs both CMSR and CMIR with a single model, using a dual-contrastive loss at both the local patch-point level and the image-point cloud level, but not a scene/instance-level contrastive loss. This allows improved retrieval when compared to methods that encode the whole 3D map either as global point cloud features or scene graphs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出CrossWeave,这是一个全新的多模式框架,既以单一模式执行CMSR和CMIR,又使用局部补丁点和图像点云层的双重相接损失,但不是场景/内地级相接损失。 与将整个三维地图编码为全局点云特性或场景图的方法相比,这可以改进检索。

blocks.en: We show that adding local patch-point alignment consistently improves both CMSR and CMIR over training on aggregated descriptors alone, with the largest gains on fine-grained instance retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,增加局部补丁点对接,将持续改善CMSR和CMIR,而不是仅仅对汇总描述符进行培训,在精细的实例检索方面收获最大。

blocks.en: We achieve state-of-the-art performance on 3RScan and ScanNet, outperforming competing baselines by 21 points on scene retrieval and 8 points on instance retrieval on ScanNet.
blocks.zh: 我们在3RScan和ScanNet上实现了最先进的性能,在现场检索中比竞争基准高出21分,在ScanNet上比竞争基准高出8分。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-modal Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运学习

blocks.en: Multi-modal representation learning aims to align heterogeneous data sources within a shared embedding space. In this setting, contrastive learning has become the dominant paradigm. CLIP [ 25 ] demonstrated that large-scale contrastive training on paired image-text data yields rich representations capable of cross-modal understanding and strong zero-shot generalization to various downstream tasks. Building on this foundation, a series of works extended cross-modal alignment to the image-point cloud [ 40 , 44 ] and text-image-point cloud modalities [ 35 , 36 , 15 ] with Uni3D [ 43 ] scaling model and dataset sizes used for training. Subsequently, ImageBind [ 9 ] performed alignment between six modalities by leveraging images as a hub and demonstrated emergent relationships between untrained pairs. Similarly, PointBind [ 10 ] incorporated the 3D modality and performed various downstream tasks by augmenting with an LLM. However, these methods remained restricted to object-level point clouds. CLIP 2 [ 38 ] extended multi-modal representation learning to scene-level point clouds, yet remained focused on semantic understanding rather than retrieval. Overall, prior work focuses on cross-modal alignment for semantic understanding, with comparatively less emphasis on retrieval-oriented representation design for 3D scenes.
blocks.zh: 开展多模式代表性学习的目的是在共享嵌入空间内统一各种数据来源。 在这种背景下,对比性学习成为了主导范式. CLIP [25] 表明,对成对图像文本数据进行大规模对比性培训,会产生丰富的能跨模式理解的表示,并强烈地将零射入各种下游任务。 在这一基础上,一系列工程将跨模式对接延伸至图像点云[40,44]和文本图像点云模式[35,36,15],并配有Uni3D[43]缩放模型和用于培训的数据集尺寸. 随后,ImageBind[9]通过将图像作为中枢来进行六种模式之间的对接,并展示了未经训练的对子之间的新兴关系. 同样地,PointBind [10]采用了3D模式,并通过LLM的增强来完成各种下游任务. 然而,这些方法仍然局限于对象级点云. CLIP 2 [38] 将多式代表学习扩展至场景级点云,但依然侧重于语义理解而不是取回. 总体而言,先前的工作侧重于语义理解的跨模式对接,相对较少强调3D场景的取回取回导向的表示设计.

blocks.en: 2.2 Uni-modal and Cross-modal Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.2 单式和跨式检索

blocks.en: Retrieval methods aim to identify relevant database entries given a query, typically represented by a global descriptor. While early methods aggregated local features via hand-crafted clustering [ 13 ] , later works introduced learned aggregation like NetVLAD [ 1 ] to preserve distributional structure. Uni-modal visual [ 1 , 14 ] and LiDAR-based [ 30 , 31 , 37 , 24 , 42 ] place recognition are widely studied along these lines. In the cross-modal domain, image-text retrieval is well-established [ 3 ] , heavily driven by contrastive joint-embedding alignment [ 25 , 17 , 28 ] . Extending beyond 2D, recent works bridge textual queries with 3D point clouds via part-to-word matching [ 29 ] and multi-modal consistencies [ 26 , 8 ] . Concurrently, scene graphs are used to capture explicit structural relations for cross-modal text-to-image retrieval, evolving from basic query parsing [ 12 ] to advanced message passing and attribute alignment [ 6 , 33 ] . Despite these advances, cross-modal scene and instance retrieval remains largely underexplored, particularly for indoor environments mapped between images and 3D point clouds.
blocks.zh: 检索方法旨在识别给出查询的相关数据库条目,通常以全球描述符为代表。 虽然早期的方法通过手工集成[13]汇总了本地特征,后期的作品引入了NetVLAD[1]等所学集成,以保持分布结构. 根据这些思路,广泛研究了基于LiDAR的单式视觉[1,14]和基于[30,31,37,24,42]的位置识别. 在跨模式域中,图像文本检索已经确立[3],由对比性联合嵌入式对接[25,17,28]所大力推动. 延伸至2D以外,近期的作品通过部分对字匹配[29]和多模式成分[26,8]将3D点云的文字查询进行通接. 同时,场景图用于捕捉跨模式文本到图像检索的明示结构关系,从基本查询解析[12]演变为高级消息传递和属性对接[6,33]. 尽管取得了这些进展,但跨模式的场景和实例取回在很大程度上仍然没有得到充分利用,特别是在图像和三维点云之间的室内环境中。

blocks.en: The most closely related work to ours is CrossOver [ 27 ] , which trains for cross-modal alignment across text, images, floorplans, CAD models, and point clouds at both scene and instance levels, enabling retrieval across any pair of these modalities at multiple levels of granularity. We highlight two design aspects of prior work most relevant to our setting. First, instance- and scene-level retrieval rely on separate task-specific checkpoints, requiring distinct models for different granularities and limiting flexibility at inference time. Second, scene-level representations are constructed by averaging per-frame features (CLS and mean patch tokens) across frames for images and mean pooling point features for point clouds, which implicitly assigns equal weight to all local features, potentially losing fine-grained structural information critical for distinguishing visually similar scenes. In contrast, our method uses a unified model that learns fine-grained patch-to-point correspondences, which can be flexibly aggregated at inference time to support both instance- and scene-level retrieval. Furthermore, our aggregation assigns local features to shared cluster centers, capturing their distributional structure rather than averaging them away.
blocks.zh: 与我们最密切相关的工作是CrossOver [27],它为跨文本、图像、平面图、CAD模型和点云进行跨模式的校正,在现场和实例两个层面都进行取用,从而能够在多颗粒度的多层次上跨越任何一种模式。 我们强调与我们的环境最相关的先前工作的两个设计方面。 首先,实例和场景一级的检索依靠不同任务的具体检查站,需要不同颗粒的不同模型,在推断时间限制灵活性。 第二,场景层面的表示方式是通过对图像的跨帧平均(CLS和平均补丁符号)和点云的平均集合点特性构建出场景层面的表示方式,这些表示方式暗含着对所有局部特征的等分权重,有可能失去对区分视觉相近场景至关重要的精细刻度结构信息. 相形之下,我们的方法采用统一模式,学习精细的补丁到点的函证,在推断时间可以灵活地汇总,支持实例级和场景级的检索. 此外,我们的汇总将地方特征分配给共享集群中心,捕捉它们的分布结构,而不是将它们平均。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The design philosophy behind CrossWeave is to both: effectively utilize the redundancy in the 3D scene structure and not lose fine-grained details due to the aggregation process over the local features to obtain modality-specific descriptors. Figure 1 provides an overview of CrossWeave.
blocks.zh: CrossWeave背后的设计哲学是既要:有效利用3D场景结构中的冗余,又不能因为聚合过程超越了局部特征而丢失精细的细节来获得模式特有描述符. 图1概述了CrossWeave的情况。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of CrossWeave. CrossWeave learns cross-modal retrieval representations from sparse image patch-3D point correspondences rather than scene- or instance-level labels. Scene Sampling: Given calibrated RGB-D observations and a reconstructed 3D map, visible patch-point pairs are obtained by projecting 3D points into the image plane, filtering occluded points using rendered depth, quantizing valid pixels into DINOv2 patch tokens, and selecting a compact semantically diverse subset using feature-space farthest point sampling. Feature Extraction: Frozen encoders extract local patch and point features, which are projected by learnable projection matrices W patch W^{\mathrm{patch}} and W point W^{\mathrm{point}} into a shared embedding space. Feature Aggregation: A shared SALAD aggregator then maps variable-sized sets of local features into fixed-dimensional descriptors. Training combines a local patch-point ℒ p ​ 2 ​ p \mathcal{L}_{p2p} contrastive loss with an aggregated image-point-cloud contrastive loss ℒ i ​ 2 ​ p ​ c \mathcal{L}_{i2pc} , preserving fine-grained alignment while organizing local evidence into retrieval-ready descriptors. At inference, the same encoders and projection heads serve both tasks: SALAD descriptors are used for scene retrieval and mean-pooled local features for instance retrieval.

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture and Training
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑和培训

blocks.en: In keeping with the convention in previous CMSR literature, we assume the 3D structure consists of individual RGB-D scans aligned into a single 3D map and not the individual scans themselves.
blocks.zh: 根据以往CMSR文献中的常规,我们假设3D结构由单个RGB-D扫描组成,对齐为一单一的3D地图,而不是单个扫描本身.

blocks.en: To exploit the redundancy present in both image and point-cloud observations, we avoid encoding all 3D points visible in an image and instead construct a compact set of informative patch-point correspondences. Given a point cloud P P , we first project each 3D point into the image plane using the camera intrinsics K K and camera pose [ R ∣ t ] [R\mid t] . Since projection alone does not guarantee that a point is actually visible from the camera viewpoint, we apply an explicit visibility constraint using the depth map rendered from the reconstructed mesh. A projected point is retained only if its depth lies within a small tolerance ϵ \epsilon of the observed depth at the corresponding pixel. This removes occluded points and ensures that the resulting correspondences reflect physically visible image-geometry associations. These correspondences are the only supervision used during training, and no scene or instance labels are required.
blocks.zh: 为了利用图像和点云观测中存在的冗余,我们避免将图像中可见的所有3D点编码,而是构建一套紧凑的信息补丁点通信. 鉴于一个点云 P,我们首先将每个3D点投射入图像平面,使用相机内在的K K和相机摆出[R t ] [R\mid t]. 由于光是投影并不能保证某一点从相机角度实际可见,所以我们使用从被重建的网状图所渲染的深度图来实施明显的能见度限制. 只有当它的深度位于相应像素所观测到的深度的小型可容忍度 \\\\ epsilon 时,才会保留一个预测点。 这样做可以去除被围住的分数,并确保由此产生的函文反映实际可见的图像-几何关联. 这些信件是训练期间使用的唯一监督,不需要场景或实例标签.

blocks.en: The remaining valid pixel-point pairs are then quantized into image patch indices using a patch size of 14 14 , following the patchification scheme of DINOv2 [ 22 ] . For each image patch, we randomly sample a single visible 3D point, producing a one-to-one patch-point mapping. This step reduces the strong local redundancy caused by multiple 3D points projecting to the same visual token, while preserving the spatial correspondence required for patch-level cross-modal supervision.
blocks.zh: 剩下的有效像素点对再用14 14 的补丁大小,按照DINOv2 [22] 的补丁方案被分解为图像补丁指数. 对于每个图像补丁,我们随机抽取出单个可见的3D点,生成一对一的补丁点映射. 这一步骤减少了由多个3D点投射到同一种视觉符号所引发的强烈局部冗余,同时保留了补丁级跨模式监管所需的空间通信.

blocks.en: Finally, we further downsample these patch-point pairs using Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) [ 7 ] in feature space rather than Euclidean space. Specifically, FPS is applied to the point features extracted by our frozen 3D encoder, Utonia [ 41 ] , a recent point-cloud feature extractor based on the Point Transformer v3 architecture [ 34 ] . Unlike geometric FPS, which primarily encourages spatial coverage, feature-space FPS encourages semantic diversity by selecting points that are maximally separated in the learned embedding space. This prevents the sampled set from being dominated by large or frequently observed objects in the field of view, yielding a more balanced set of local correspondences for contrastive learning. The output of this scene sampling is a set of point-patch pairs { p i ∈ ℝ 3 , q i ∈ ℝ 14 × 14 } , i = 1 → N \{p_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3},q_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{14\times 14}\},i=1\rightarrow N .

blocks.en: For each image-point-cloud sample, we aggregate the N N sampled patch-point correspondences into fixed-dimensional descriptors using a SALAD [ 11 ] aggregation layer. Here, N N denotes the number of retained patch-point pairs after visibility filtering and sampling, while K K denotes the number of latent aggregation clusters used by SALAD. The goal of this aggregation is to summarize a compact set of local cross-modal correspondences into a single descriptor, while capturing discriminative and recurring patterns in the cross-modal data. Importantly, aggregation is performed only over the N N sampled correspondences from one image-point-cloud pair, rather than over all points in a full scene or features of an object instance.

blocks.en: CrossWeave is trained with two complementary contrastive objectives, both based on InfoNCE [ 21 , 20 ] . The first objective, the local patch-point loss ℒ p2p \mathcal{L}_{\text{p2p}} , is computed over all M = B × N M=B\times N patch-point correspondences in a batch, where B B is the batch size and N N is the number of sampled correspondences per image. This loss directly aligns local visual and geometric features, encouraging each image patch to be close to its corresponding 3D point while treating other patch-point pairs in the batch as negatives. Since it is defined only at the correspondence level, it does not require scene-level or instance-level annotations.
blocks.zh: CrossWeave的培训有两个互补的对比目标,两者都基于InfoNCE [21, 20]. 第一个目标,本地补丁点损失 L p2p\ mathcal{L}_{\text{p2p}, 计算在所有 M = B× (中文(简体) ). N M=B\时间 分批进行N补丁点通信,其中B B为批量大小,N N为每幅图像所抽样通信的数量. 这种丢失直接将局部视觉和几何特征对齐,鼓励每个图像补丁接近其相应的3D点,同时将批次中的其他补丁点对作为负数处理. 由于它仅被定义为函证层面,因此不需要场景层面或实例层面的说明.

blocks.en: The second objective, the image-point-cloud loss ℒ i2pc \mathcal{L}_{\text{i2pc}} realized as the InfoNCE loss as well, is applied to the SALAD-aggregated descriptors of each image-point-cloud pair in the batch. This loss encourages the aggregated image descriptor and the corresponding aggregated point-cloud descriptor to occupy a shared retrieval space. Unlike full-scene supervision, this alignment is derived from descriptors built only from the sampled local correspondences, preserving the focus on sparse but discriminative cross-modal evidence.
blocks.zh: 第二个目标,图像点- 云损失 Li2pc\ mathcal{L}_{\text{i2pc} 也作为 InfonCE 损失实现, 应用到批次中每个图像点- 云对的 SALAD 汇总描述符 。 这种损失鼓励集成图像描述符和相应的集成点-云描述符占用共享的检索空间. 与全景监理不同,这种校正取自于只从被抽取的本地公文所建的描述符,保留了对稀有而歧视性的交叉式证据的关注.

blocks.en: The final training objective combines the local and aggregated contrastive losses, ℒ = ℒ p2p + ℒ i2pc \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{p2p}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{i2pc}} . Together, these objectives allow CrossWeave to learn retrieval-oriented representations from sparse patch-point correspondences alone. The local loss preserves fine-grained cross-modal alignment, while the aggregated loss organizes these local cues into image-level and point-cloud-level descriptors.
blocks.zh: 最终训练目标结合了本地和汇总的对比性损失,L = L p2p + L i2pc\ mathcal{L}=\Mathcal{L}_{\text{p2p}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{i2pc}}. 这些目标使CrossWeave能够仅从稀少的补丁点来学习面向检索的表述. 局部损失保留了精细的跨模式对接,而汇总损失则将这些局部提示组织成图像级和点-云级描述符.

blocks.en: 3.2 Inference
blocks.zh: 3.2 推论

blocks.en: Although CrossWeave is trained only on sparse local patch-point correspondences, it can be applied directly to both scene-level and instance-level retrieval at inference. This follows from the input-agnostic design of the model. The projection layers are applied independently to each local image or point feature, and the SALAD aggregator [ 11 ] maps any variable-sized set of local features to a fixed-dimensional descriptor. Thus, the same network can aggregate a small set of training correspondences, a complete scene point cloud, or a segmented object instance without architectural modification. SALAD produces a descriptor G ∈ ℝ K ​ d cl G\in\mathbb{R}^{Kd_{\text{cl}}} , where K K is the number of learned clusters and d cl d_{\text{cl}} is the dimensionality of each cluster vector.

blocks.en: Instance-level retrieval restricts the inputs to a segmented object instance. The scene point cloud is replaced by the instance point cloud, and each query view is an RGB image together with the instance mask, of which only the patch tokens covered by the mask are used. For instance retrieval we use the local features directly instead of the SALAD descriptor: the projected patch features from all query views and the projected instance point features are each mean-pooled, and the two resulting descriptors are compared using cosine similarity. We use local features because they give better instance retrieval than the SALAD descriptor on both datasets ( Table 4 ).

blocks.zh: 3.3 执行细节

blocks.en: CrossWeave is implemented in PyTorch [ 23 ] and trained on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU using mixed-precision bfloat16 \mathrm{bfloat16} training. Training requires 17.1 GB of VRAM and about 21 GPU hours. We use the AdamW optimizer [ 16 ] with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} , and train for 30 epochs with a batch size of 16. During training, each sample contains 32 patch-point correspondences. DINOv2-L produces 1024-dimensional image patch features, and Utonia produces 1224-dimensional point features. These are projected into a shared 1024-dimensional embedding space using modality-specific projection matrices W patch W_{\text{patch}} and W point W_{\text{point}} . The SALAD aggregator uses K = 24 K=24 cluster vectors with d cl = 128 d_{\text{cl}}=128 , producing a final descriptor of dimension K × d cl = 24 × 128 = 3072 K\times d_{\text{cl}}=24\times 128=3072 . We measure inference time on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU using 10 query images of resolution 3 × 518 × 518 3\times 518\times 518 and a point cloud of 50,000 50{,}000 points. The RGB forward pass (DINOv2 + SALAD) runs in 118.69 ± 1.87 118.69\pm 1.87 ms and the point cloud forward pass (Utonia + SALAD) runs in 332.15 ± 4.52 332.15\pm 4.52 ms, with a combined peak memory usage of 5.24 5.24 GB. In practice, the point cloud database descriptors are computed offline and cached, so only the RGB forward pass is required at query time.

blocks.en: 4.2 Tasks and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 任务和计量

blocks.en: For both scene-level and instance-level retrieval, we report Top- k k accuracy , defined as the percentage of queries for which the correct scene or instance appears among the top- k k retrieved results. For instance retrieval, we additionally report Recall@ k k % (R@ k k %), which measures the percentage of scenes for which at least k k % of the query instances are correctly retrieved.
blocks.zh: 对于两个场景级别和实例级别检索,我们报告Top-k k的精确度,定义是,在Top-k检索结果中出现正确场景或实例的查询百分比。 例如检索, 我们额外报告 Recall@ k k% (R@ k k%) , 它测量至少可正确检索到 k k % 查询的场景的百分比 。

blocks.en: In the scene retrieval task, the query consists of 10 RGB views of a scene, selected following the protocol of CrossOver [ 27 ] , and the database consists of 3D point clouds reconstructed from scanned scenes. A retrieval is considered correct if the model retrieves the point cloud corresponding to the queried scene. The database includes both original scans and re-scans, where the same environment may be captured again after objects have been displaced.
blocks.zh: 在场景检索任务中,查询包含一个场景的10个RGB视图,按照CrossOver[27]协议选择,数据库由从扫描场景重建而成的3D点云组成. 如果模型取回与被询问场景相对应的点云,则检索被认为是正确的. 数据库包括原始扫描和再扫描,在物体被转移后,可以再次捕捉到同样的环境.

blocks.en: In the instance retrieval task, the query consists of multiple RGB views of an object instance, each with its instance mask. The model must retrieve the corresponding 3D object point cloud from the instance point clouds of the scene the query was taken from. The task therefore evaluates fine-grained object matching within a known environment. Top- k k accuracy is computed within each scene and averaged over all validation scenes.
blocks.zh: 在实例检索任务中,查询包含一个对象实例的多个RGB视图,每个都带有其实例掩码. 模型必须从取出查询的场景的例点云取回相应的3D对象点云. 因此,任务评价了已知环境中的细纹对象相配. 在每个场景中计算出最高的 -- k k 精度, 并对所有验证场景进行平均计算 。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en: Our primary baseline is CrossOver [ 27 ] . We evaluate two publicly released CrossOver checkpoints for each task: one trained on the same datasets as our method, and another checkpoint of the same model trained on additional data, which we denote CrossOver † . To ensure that performance differences are not caused by the choice of 3D encoder, we also retrain CrossOver on its original preprocessed training data after replacing its 3D backbone with Utonia [ 41 ] ; we refer to this variant as CrossOver (Updated) . All methods are evaluated with CrossOver’s evaluation protocol for a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们的首要基线是CrossOver [27]. 我们评价了为每项任务公开发布的两个交叉检查站:一个是经过与我们的方法相同的数据集培训的检查站,另一个是经过补充数据培训的同一模式检查站,我们表示交叉检查站。 为确保性能差异不会由3D编码器的选择所引起,我们还在用Utonia[41]取代了3D主干线后,重新训练CrossOver的原始预处理训练数据;我们称这个变体为CrossOver(更新). 所有方法都与CrossOver的评价协议进行公平比较。

blocks.en: Scene retrieval results are reported in Table 1 . CrossWeave consistently outperforms all baselines on both ScanNet and 3RScan across all retrieval ranks. On ScanNet, CrossWeave achieves a Top-1 recall of 61.54 61.54 , improving over CrossOver (Updated) by 21.16 21.16 points. The gains remain strong at higher ranks, where CrossWeave reaches 99.36 99.36 Top-5 recall and perfect Top-10 recall. These results indicate that the correct scene is almost always ranked among the first few retrieved candidates.
blocks.zh: 场景检索结果见表1。 CrossWeave在ScanNet和3RScan所有检索级别上的业绩始终高于所有基线。 在ScanNet上,CrossWeave实现了61.54 61.54的Top-1回想,比CrossOver(更新)提高了21.16 21.16分. 在较高级别上,成绩仍然强劲,CrossWeave达到99.36 99.36次Top-5召回和完美的Top-10召回. 这些结果显示,正确的场景几乎总是排在第一批被检索的候选人中。

blocks.en: The improvement is particularly meaningful because CrossOver (Updated) uses the same Utonia backbone. This suggests that the performance gain does not simply come from stronger 3D encoding, but from our training strategy based on sparse local patch-point supervision. By aligning local image patches with corresponding 3D points, CrossWeave learns descriptors that preserve fine-grained geometric and visual correspondences. This helps disambiguate scenes with similar global layouts, such as corridors, bedrooms, or repeated furniture arrangements, where purely global descriptors can collapse visually similar environments.
blocks.zh: 这一改进特别有意义,因为CrossOver(更新)使用同样的Utonia骨干. 这表明性能增益不仅仅来自更强大的3D编码,还来自我们基于稀少的局部补丁点监督的训练策略. CrossWeave通过将本地图像补丁与相应的3D分对齐来学习保存精细的几何和视觉相通的描述符. 这有助于用类似的全球布局,如走廊、卧室或重复的家具安排来拆散场景,因为纯粹的全球描述可以崩溃视觉上类似的环境。

blocks.en: On 3RScan, CrossWeave shows the same trend. It achieves a Top-1 recall of 46.50 46.50 , compared to 23.57 23.57 for CrossOver (Updated), corresponding to a 22.93 22.93 point improvement. CrossWeave also improves Top-5 recall from 66.88 66.88 to 85.99 85.99 and Top-10 recall from 84.71 84.71 to 92.36 92.36 . These results demonstrate that local patch-point alignment generalizes across datasets and remains effective under the more challenging scene variations present in 3RScan. We also observe that CrossOver † does not improve over the base CrossOver model, suggesting that additional training data alone is insufficient without a training objective that explicitly encourages cross-modal local alignment.
blocks.zh: 在3RScan,克罗斯 织布呈现出同样的趋势. 它的Top-1召回率为46.50 46.50分,而CrossOver(更新)则为23.57 23.57分,相当于22.93 22.93分的提高. 交叉 编织还改进了Top-5回想,从66.88 66.88回想到85.99 85.99回想,Top-10回想从84.71 84.71回想到92.36 92.36回想. 这些结果表明,在3RScan中,局部的补丁点对接一般是跨数据集的,在更具有挑战性的场景变化下仍然有效。 我们还注意到,CrossOver ++没有改进基础CrossOver模型,这表明,没有明确鼓励当地交叉模式协调的培训目标,仅仅增加培训数据是不够的。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows a representative qualitative example on ScanNet. blocks.en: Across scenes on ScanNet, the difference between methods becomes more pronounced at stricter recall thresholds. This suggests that CrossWeave is especially effective when the task requires retrieving a larger fraction of all correct instances, rather than only identifying the easiest matches.

blocks.en: Overall, the instance retrieval results support the same conclusion as the scene retrieval experiments: sparse local patch-point alignment provides a stronger cross-modal training signal than instance-level supervision alone. While the baselines are often sufficient to retrieve a small number of easy matches, CrossWeave is more reliable under stricter retrieval criteria, where the model must recover a broader and more complete set of correct instances. blocks.en: We ablate the main design choices of CrossWeave in Table 4 . Specifically, we study the effect of the local patch-point alignment loss ℒ p ​ 2 ​ p \mathcal{L}_{p2p} , the image-point-cloud aggregation loss ℒ i ​ 2 ​ p ​ c \mathcal{L}_{i2pc} , the aggregation used during training (mean pooling or SALAD), and the choice of retrieval features. We compare three feature variants: salad , which uses the aggregated descriptor produced by the SALAD module; local , which mean-pools the patch and point features; and hybrid , which uses salad features for scene retrieval and local features for instance retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了CrossWeave在表4中的主要设计选择. 具体来说,我们研究本地补丁点对齐损失L p 2 p\ mathcal{L}_{p2p},图像点-云集损失Li 2 p c\mathcal{L}_{i2pc},训练中使用的集合(平均集合或SALAD),以及检索特性的选择. 我们比较了三个特性变体:沙拉,它使用由 SALAD 模块生成的集合描述符; 本地的,它将补丁和分点的特性集合起来; 混合的,它使用沙拉的特性进行场景检索,以及本地的特性,例如检索。

On ScanNet, using salad features, CrossWeave improves scene Top-1 recall from 57.37 57.37 to 61.54 61.54 , instance Top-1 recall from 73.33 73.33 to 77.04 77.04 , and instance R ​ @ ​ 75 % R@75\% from 56.09 56.09 to 66.67 66.67 . These gains indicate that sparse local patch-point correspondences provide a stronger training signal than global image-point-cloud supervision alone, especially for fine-grained instance retrieval.

blocks.en: Training with only ℒ p ​ 2 ​ p \mathcal{L}_{p2p} and mean-pooled local features already gives strong instance retrieval, with 78.96 78.96 and 73.30 73.30 instance Top-1 recall on ScanNet and 3RScan. Scene retrieval, however, drops to 47.12 47.12 and 27.39 27.39 Top-1 recall, compared to 61.54 61.54 and 46.50 46.50 for the main model. Local alignment therefore learns discriminative object-level features, but does not by itself produce descriptors that separate scenes. Adding ℒ i ​ 2 ​ p ​ c \mathcal{L}_{i2pc} while keeping mean pooling improves scene Top-1 recall from 47.12 47.12 to 52.24 52.24 on ScanNet and from 27.39 27.39 to 30.57 30.57 on 3RScan, so the aggregated objective provides supervision that the local loss does not. Replacing mean pooling with SALAD further improves scene Top-1 recall to 61.54 61.54 and 46.50 46.50 . Hence, both the aggregation objective and the aggregation module contribute to scene retrieval. Mean pooling with both losses gives the highest instance Top-1 recall ( 79.63 79.63 and 73.62 73.62 ), slightly above the main model ( 78.77 78.77 and 73.50 73.50 ), but its scene Top-1 recall is 9.30 9.30 and 15.93 15.93 points lower.

blocks.en: For scene-level retrieval, salad features consistently outperform local features. Without ℒ p ​ 2 ​ p \mathcal{L}_{p2p} , the SALAD baseline achieves 57.37 57.37 Top-1 scene recall on ScanNet, compared to 38.14 38.14 when using local features. On 3RScan, the gap is even larger, with salad achieving 43.95 43.95 compared to 19.75 19.75 for local . The same pattern holds for CrossWeave: salad features achieve 61.54 61.54 scene Top-1 recall on ScanNet and 46.50 46.50 on 3RScan, whereas local features achieve only 48.40 48.40 and 28.66 28.66 , respectively. This confirms that scene retrieval benefits from a parametric aggregation module over mean-pooled local features.
blocks.zh: 就场景级检索而言,沙拉特征一直优于本地特征。 没有了L p 2 p\ mathcal{L}_{p2p},SALAD基线在ScanNet上实现了57.37 57.37 Top-1场景回想,而使用本地特性时则达到了38.14 38.14. 在3RScan,差距更大,沙拉达到43.95 43.95,而当地为19.75 19.75。 CrossWeave也有同样的模式:沙拉特征在ScanNet上实现了61.54 61.54场景Top-1回想,在3RScan上实现了46.50 46.50回想,而本地特征分别只有48.40 48.40回想和28.66回想. 28.66回想. 这证实,场景检索比平均集合的本地特性更受益于一个参数汇总模块。

blocks.en: In contrast, instance retrieval benefits more from preserving local feature structure. For CrossWeave on ScanNet, using local features improves instance Top-1 recall from 77.04 77.04 to 78.77 78.77 and R@75% from 66.67 66.67 to 67.95 67.95 compared to salad features. On 3RScan, the improvement is larger: instance Top-1 recall increases from 70.01 70.01 to 73.50 73.50 , and R ​ @ ​ 75 % R@75\% improves from 43.31 43.31 to 49.68 49.68 . This suggests that aggregation can discard fine-grained spatial and geometric cues that are useful for distinguishing object instances, whereas local descriptors retain the detailed correspondence information required for accurate instance matching.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,实例检索从维护当地特征结构中获得更多好处。 就ScanNet上的CrossWeave而言,与沙拉特征相比,使用当地特征改进了Top-1的例回顾,从77.04 77.04回溯到78.77 78.77回溯,R@75%回溯到66.67回溯到67.95 67.95回溯。 在3RScan,改善幅度更大:实例Top-1召回量从70.01 70.01增至73.50 73.50;R@75% R@75\%从43.31 43.31增至49.68 49.68。 这表明聚合可以丢弃细纹的空间和几何提示来区分对象,而本地描述符则保留精确实例匹配所需的详细对应信息.

blocks.en: The hybrid configuration combines the strengths of both feature types by using salad descriptors for scene retrieval and local for instance retrieval. This yields the best trade-off between scene and instance retrieval across both datasets, and we therefore use this configuration as our main model.
blocks.zh: 混合配置通过使用沙拉描述符来进行场景取回和局部取回,将两种特征类型的优点结合起来. 这在两个数据集的场景和实例检索之间产生了最佳的取舍,因此我们使用这个配置作为我们的主要模型.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced CrossWeave, a novel framework for cross-modal scene and instance retrieval that demonstrates the superiority of sparse, local feature alignment over traditional global scene encoding. By pairing a local patch-to-point contrastive objective with optimal transport-based aggregation, CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art scene and instance retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a single model, trained without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives. CrossWeave provides a flexible alternative for bridging the modality gap in spatial reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了CrossWeave,这是一个跨模式场景和实例检索的新框架,它显示了稀少的局部地貌组合优于传统的全球场景编码. CrossWeave通过将本地补丁-点对比目标与基于运输的最佳汇总相配,在ScanNet和3RScan上实现最先进的场景和实例检索,采用单一模式,未经场景或实例级对比目标培训。 CrossWeave为弥合空间推理任务中模式差距提供了一个灵活的替代方案.

blocks.en: Appendix A Data Pre-processing and Training Optimization Details

blocks.en: Both datasets are preprocessed by temporally subsampling the RGB-D frames: one in every 30 frames for ScanNet and one in every 5 frames for 3RScan, chosen according to the typical sequence length of each dataset. This yields 63,683 training images from ScanNet and 56,883 from 3RScan, for a total of 120,566 training images. For scene-level evaluation we use the 312 ScanNet and 157 3RScan validation scans. For instance-level evaluation we use 6,419 ScanNet and 3,274 3RScan validation instances.
blocks.zh: 两个数据集都通过时间上对RGB-D框架的分样进行预处理:ScanNet每30个框架有一个,3RScan每5个框架有一个,按照每个数据集的典型序列长度选择. 这样从ScanNet获得63 683个培训图像,从3RScan获得56 883个培训图像,共计120 566个培训图像。 为了进行场景评价,我们使用312 ScanNet和157 3RScan验证扫描。 例如,我们利用了6 419个ScanNet和3 274 3RScan验证实例。

blocks.en: To reduce dataloader overhead, projected pixel-point correspondences are precomputed and cached as .pt files, while FPS downsampling and patch-point pair generation are performed online. Utonia point features are also cached to avoid redundant forward passes over the same point clouds during training.
blocks.zh: 为了减少数据装载器的起落架,预测的像素点对应被预先计算并被缓存为.pt文件,而FPS下取样和补丁点对子生成则在线进行. 乌托尼亚点特征也被缓存,以避免在训练期间被多余地通过同点云.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Scaling
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据缩放

blocks.en: We study scene retrieval performance as a function of training data volume. The results reported in the main paper use 120,566 images from ScanNet and 3RScan as described in Appendix A . To study the effect of data scaling, we subsample the training set by uniform striding. As shown in Figure 4 , CrossWeave is stable across data regimes: even at 10% of the full training set, the model outperforms the previous state of the art. We attribute the data efficiency of our model to two factors: feature-space FPS during patch-point pair selection, which ensures semantic diversity within each batch, and the use of strong pre-trained encoders for each modality, which provide rich local features from the outset. Together, these properties mean that even a small number of uniformly sampled images contains sufficient supervision signal to learn a discriminative cross-modal representation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究场景检索性能 作为培训数据量的函数。 主文中所报告的结果使用了附录A所描述的ScanNet和3RScan的120,566个图像。 为了研究数据缩放的效果,我们通过统一分解来对训练集进行分解. 如图4所示,CrossWeave跨数据系统是稳定的:即便在全套培训的10%,该模型的表现也超过了之前的先进水平. 我们把模型的数据效率归结于两个因素:在补丁点对选择期间的地物-空间FPS,它确保了每批中语义的多样性;对每种模式使用强大的事先训练的编码器,从一开始就提供了丰富的局部特征. 这些特性加在一起,意味着即使是少数统一取样的图像也包含足够的监督信号来学习一种歧视性的跨模式表现.

blocks.en: Appendix C Effect of Scaling Camera Views
blocks.zh: 缩放相机视图的效果

blocks.en: Figure 5 reports scene retrieval performance as a function of the number of query camera views at inference. Top-1 recall improves from 45.83 to 64.10 on ScanNet and from 28.66 to 49.68 on 3RScan as the number of views increases from 3 to 30. Most of the gain comes between 3 and 10 views; beyond 10 views, recall still improves by up to 2.56 points on ScanNet and 4.46 points on 3RScan. This behavior is a direct consequence of the architecture: because the SALAD aggregator maps a variable number of input features into a fixed-dimensional descriptor, CrossWeave naturally incorporates additional views without any retraining or architectural modification. In contrast, CrossOver [ 27 ] averages per-frame features with equal weight, and its authors report that performance stabilizes after 10 frames, with additional frames giving only slight improvements. CrossWeave continues to improve up to 25–30 views, since SALAD assigns patch features to clusters rather than averaging them. The ability to leverage more views at inference is particularly valuable in practical deployments, where a robot or AR device may capture varying numbers of observations depending on the environment.

blocks.en: The instance retrieval results in Table 2 use ground-truth instance masks for both the query images and the database point clouds. In deployment, these masks come from a segmentation model and contain errors. We therefore evaluate the main model, with local features for instance retrieval, under noisy 2D masks, noisy 3D masks, and both. For 2D, we generate masks with MobileSAM [ 39 ] , prompted with a single point sampled well inside the ground-truth mask to mimic a human click, and keep the predicted mask with the highest IoU to the ground truth. blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制

blocks.en: Despite strong performance on most benchmarks, CrossWeave has several limitations. First, at inference, CrossWeave assumes that query images are captured within a single viewing session; queries that span multiple sessions are not explicitly handled. Second, the training correspondences are derived from the camera intrinsics, camera poses, depth rendered from the reconstructed mesh, and the reconstruction itself. Errors in calibration or pose, missing or inaccurate rendered depth, and incomplete or noisy reconstructions produce incorrect or missing patch-point pairs. We use the reconstructions and poses provided with ScanNet and 3RScan and do not study the effect of such errors. Finally, instance retrieval requires segmented instances, both as query masks and as database point clouds, making retrieval quality dependent on the upstream segmentation, which is outside the scope of this work. Appendix D shows that retrieval degrades under noisy 2D and 3D masks, most strongly at R@75%.
blocks.zh: 尽管在大多数基准上表现强劲,CrossWeave有几种局限性. 首先,CrossWeave推断,查询图像是在单个取景会话中捕获的;跨越多个会话的查询没有明确处理. 第二,训练函文取自相机所固有的相机,相机的姿势,从被重建的网状所得到的深度,以及重建本身. 校正错误或姿势错误、缺失或不准确使深度变为不完全或吵闹的重建产生不正确或缺失的补丁点对。 我们使用ScanNet和3RScan提供的重建和姿势,不研究这些错误的影响。 最后,实例检索需要分解实例,既作为查询口罩,又作为数据库点云,使得检索质量依赖于上游分解,而上游分解不属于这项工作的范围. 附 录 D显示,在吵闹的2D和3D口罩下,检索会降解,最强烈的是R@75%.

blocks.en: Appendix I Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录一 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: CrossWeave enhances spatial intelligence for indoor robotics, autonomous navigation, and mixed-reality systems through efficient cross-modal localization. However, by relying on pre-trained foundation models (DINOv2 and Utonia), it risks inheriting and propagating their latent training biases. This could result in disparate retrieval performance across culturally or socioeconomically diverse architectural styles, causing the system to underperform in underrepresented environments. Real-world deployments must actively audit these underlying models to mitigate biased spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: CrossWeave通过高效的跨模式本地化,增强室内机器人的空间智能,自主导航,和混合真实性系统. 然而,通过依赖预先培训的基础模型(DINOv2和Utonia),它有可能继承并传播其潜在的培训偏见。 这可能导致不同文化或不同社会经济建筑风格的检索业绩不一,导致该系统在代表性不足的环境中表现不佳。 现实世界的部署必须积极审计这些基本模式,以缓解偏颇的空间推理。
